contents.name: authorities

components.name: list
components.element:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <ConfigField resource="user" name="tags" source="tags">
  <TransformInput expression="{parse: text => `{name: '${text}'}`, format: text => text ? text.replace(new RegExp(`.*'(.*)'.*`), '$1') : '', choices: tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag})), source}" source="tags">
   <SelectInput/>
  </TransformInput>
 </ConfigField>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <TextField source="id"/>
  <ArrayField source="tags">
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <ChipField source="name" size="small"/>
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>

components.name: create
components.element:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <PasswordInput source="password" validate={[minLength(5)]}/>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Tags">
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <ConfigField resource="user" name="tags">
      <TransformField expression="{choices: tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))}">
       <SelectInput source="name" validate={[required()]}/>
      </TransformField>
     </ConfigField>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>
